# Terms of Use

_Version 1.0.0 · Last updated 2026-10-02_

These Terms of Use ("Terms") are an agreement between you and Calecute Technologies (OPC) Private Limited, a one person company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013 (CIN {{CIN}}), with its registered office at {{ADDRESS}} ("Calecute Technologies (OPC) Private Limited", "we", "us"). They govern your use of the I Want India app, the website at https://{{INDIA_WEB_DOMAIN}} and the seller dashboard (the "Service"). By creating an account or using the Service you agree to these Terms, our [Privacy Policy](/legal/privacy-policy) and our [Community Guidelines](/legal/community-guidelines). If you use the Service as a seller, our [Seller Terms](/legal/seller-terms) also apply.

These Terms are an electronic record under the Information Technology Act, 2000 and are published in accordance with Rule 3(1) of the Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules, 2021.

## 1. What I Want India is

I Want India is an online marketplace that lets people and businesses in India ("buyers") post requests for products and services, and lets independent businesses ("sellers") send quotes in response. Calecute Technologies (OPC) Private Limited acts as an **intermediary** within the meaning of Section 2(1)(w) of the Information Technology Act, 2000, and as a marketplace e-commerce entity under the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020.

**Calecute Technologies (OPC) Private Limited is not a party to any transaction between a buyer and a seller.** We do not sell, manufacture, stock, deliver, install or inspect any product, and we do not perform any service listed on the Service. Sellers are independent businesses, not our employees, agents or partners. We do not guarantee the quality, safety, legality, timing or price of any item or service, the accuracy of any quote, request or listing, or that a buyer or seller will complete a transaction. Any contract for goods or services is made directly between the buyer and the seller, and the seller is responsible for the goods, services, warranties, GST invoices and compliance with law.

## 2. Eligibility and accounts

- You must be at least 18 years old and competent to contract under the Indian Contract Act, 1872. The Service is not for children.
- You must be resident in India or (for sellers) operate a business in India.
- You sign in with a +91 mobile number verified by one-time code, Google or Apple. Keep your account secure; you are responsible for activity under it. Tell us at {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}} if you suspect unauthorised use.
- Give accurate information and keep it up to date. One person may hold one buyer account; a business may hold one seller profile unless we agree otherwise.

## 3. Posting requests (buyers)

- Describe what you want honestly and only post requests you genuinely intend to consider. Requests cannot be for blocked categories listed in the [Community Guidelines](/legal/community-guidelines).
- You may set a budget (and hide it from sellers), a needed-by date, a location (PIN code or map pin) and a quote window. Matching sellers are notified; up to 10 quotes may be received per request.
- Your exact address and phone number are shared only with the seller whose quote you accept.
- Accepting a quote closes the request to new quotes and tells the seller you want to proceed. It is not a payment. You and the seller then agree the final details directly.

## 4. Quotes, payment and delivery

- Quotes are offers made by sellers. A seller is responsible for its quote, including price, GST (prices include GST unless the quote says otherwise, with CGST/SGST or IGST shown), delivery or installation charges, warranty, return policy and validity.
- In the current version of the Service, **payment is made directly between buyer and seller** (for example UPI, cash or card on delivery) outside the Service. We do not hold, process or guarantee buyer payments, and we are not responsible for refunds between buyers and sellers. Always ask for a GST invoice, and never pay advance amounts to a seller you have not verified.
- Problems with an order (late delivery, defects, warranty, returns) must be resolved with the seller. You can report a seller or raise a grievance with us and we will act under these Terms and our Community Guidelines, but we are not obliged to resolve disputes between users. You may also approach the National Consumer Helpline (1915) or a Consumer Commission.

## 5. Reviews

Only buyers whose order is marked completed may review a seller. Reviews must be honest, based on your own experience and follow the Community Guidelines and IS 19000:2022 principles on online consumer reviews. We do not accept payment to change, rank or remove reviews; we remove reviews only if they break our rules or the law. Sellers may reply publicly once.

## 6. Your content

You keep ownership of what you post (requests, photos, chat messages, reviews, profile content). You give Calecute Technologies (OPC) Private Limited a worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free licence to host, store, reproduce, display, adapt (for example resize or translate) and distribute your content only to operate, improve and promote the Service, for as long as it is on the Service and for a reasonable time after removal (for backups and as required by law). You confirm you have the right to post it.

## 7. Prohibited content and conduct (Rule 3(1)(b) of the IT Rules)

You must not host, display, upload, modify, publish, transmit, store, update or share any information that:

1. belongs to another person and to which you do not have any right;
2. is obscene, pornographic, paedophilic, invasive of another's privacy (including bodily privacy), insulting or harassing on the basis of gender, racially or ethnically objectionable, relating to or encouraging money laundering or gambling, or promoting enmity between groups on the grounds of religion or caste with the intent to incite violence;
3. is harmful to children;
4. infringes any patent, trademark, copyright or other proprietary rights;
5. deceives or misleads the addressee about the origin of the message or knowingly and intentionally communicates misinformation or information which is patently false and untrue or misleading in nature;
6. impersonates another person;
7. threatens the unity, integrity, defence, security or sovereignty of India, friendly relations with foreign States, or public order, or causes incitement to the commission of any cognisable offence, or prevents investigation of any offence, or is insulting another nation;
8. contains software virus or any other computer code, file or program designed to interrupt, destroy or limit the functionality of any computer resource;
9. is in the nature of an online game that is not verified as a permissible online game, or is an advertisement or surrogate advertisement of such a game; or
10. violates any law for the time being in force.

You must also follow the [Community Guidelines](/legal/community-guidelines): no blocked items or services, no restricted services without the required registration, no fake or duplicate requests or quotes, no spam, scraping or bots, no circumventing rate limits or security, and no collecting other users' data.

## 8. Reporting, blocking, moderation and grievances

Every chat, request, quote, review and profile has a **Report** and **Block** option. We review reports and may remove or disable access to content, limit features, suspend or terminate accounts, and preserve information as required by law. If we remove content you posted, we will tell you the reason and you may ask us to review the decision. Complaints, including about content that violates Section 7, can be sent to our [Grievance Officer](/legal/grievance-officer), who will acknowledge them within 24 hours and resolve them within 15 days (complaints about content exposing a person's private area, nudity, sexual acts or impersonation in electronic form are acted on within 24 hours).

## 9. Fees

The Service is free for buyers. Sellers may be charged for plans and quote credits as described in the [Seller Terms](/legal/seller-terms), [Subscription Terms](/legal/subscription-terms) and [Refund and Cancellation Policy](/legal/refund-cancellation). All fees are in Indian Rupees and include GST unless stated otherwise.

## 10. Third-party services

The Service uses third-party services such as Google Maps, Google and Apple sign-in, Google Play, the App Store and Razorpay. Your use of them is subject to their terms, including the Google Maps/Google Earth Additional Terms of Service and Google's Privacy Policy. If you downloaded the app from the Apple App Store, the [EULA](/legal/eula) terms also apply.

## 11. Intellectual property

The Service, including its software, design, logos and the names "I Want India" and "I Want", belongs to Calecute Technologies (OPC) Private Limited or its licensors. We grant you a personal, revocable, non-transferable licence to use the app for its intended purpose. To report content that infringes your intellectual property, contact the [Grievance Officer](/legal/grievance-officer).

## 12. Disclaimers

The Service is provided "as is" and "as available". To the fullest extent permitted by law, Calecute Technologies (OPC) Private Limited disclaims all warranties, express or implied, including merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose and non-infringement, and any warranty about users, sellers, quotes, products or services obtained through the Service. "Verified" badges and registration checks reflect information available to us at the time of the check and are not a guarantee or endorsement.

## 13. Limitation of liability and indemnity

To the fullest extent permitted by law, Calecute Technologies (OPC) Private Limited will not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special or consequential loss, or for any loss arising from a transaction or dispute between users. Our total liability for any claim relating to the Service is limited to the greater of ₹5,000 or the amount you paid us in the 12 months before the claim. Nothing in these Terms limits any right you have under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019 that cannot be limited by contract. You agree to indemnify Calecute Technologies (OPC) Private Limited against claims arising from your content, your transactions with other users or your breach of these Terms.

## 14. Suspension and termination

You can stop using the Service and delete your account at any time (see [Account Deletion](/legal/account-deletion)). We may suspend or end your access if you break these Terms, if required by law, or to protect users. Sections 6 and 11 to 15 survive termination.

## 15. Governing law and disputes

These Terms are governed by the laws of India. Subject to your rights under consumer protection law, the courts at {{JURISDICTION_CITY}} have exclusive jurisdiction. Before going to court, please contact our [Grievance Officer](/legal/grievance-officer) so we can try to resolve the issue. We may update these Terms; we will notify you in the app of material changes at least 15 days before they take effect (except changes required by law), and ask you to accept them again.

## 16. Contact

Calecute Technologies (OPC) Private Limited, {{ADDRESS}} · {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}} · Grievance Officer: {{GRIEVANCE_OFFICER}} ({{GRIEVANCE_EMAIL}})

# Privacy Policy

_Version 1.0.0 · Last updated 2026-10-02_

This Privacy Policy explains how Calecute Technologies (OPC) Private Limited (CIN {{CIN}}) ("Calecute Technologies (OPC) Private Limited", "we", "us") collects, uses, shares and protects your personal data when you use the I Want India mobile app for Android and iOS, the website at https://{{INDIA_WEB_DOMAIN}} and the seller dashboard at https://{{INDIA_SELLER_DASHBOARD_DOMAIN}} (together, the "Service").

We are the **Data Fiduciary** for your personal data under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (the "DPDP Act") and the rules made under it, and this policy is also published under the Information Technology Act, 2000, the Information Technology (Reasonable Security Practices and Procedures and Sensitive Personal Data or Information) Rules, 2011 and the Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules, 2021 (the "IT Rules").

I Want India is a reverse marketplace for India: buyers post what they want and independent sellers send quotes. I Want India is a separate app from "I Want USA"; the two apps share no accounts and no data.

Read this policy together with our [DPDP Consent Notice](/legal/dpdp-consent-notice), which is shown to you when you sign up, and our [Grievance Officer](/legal/grievance-officer) page.

## 1. Summary

- We process only the personal data needed to run the marketplace, on the basis of **your consent** (which you can withdraw at any time) and the legitimate uses allowed by the DPDP Act.
- We **do not sell** your personal data. The app shows **no ads**, does **not track** you across other apps or websites, and does not use the Android Advertising ID or Apple's IDFA.
- Your data is stored by our database provider Supabase in **AWS ap-south-1 (Mumbai, India)**.
- A buyer's exact address and phone number are shown to a seller **only after the buyer accepts that seller's quote**.
- You can delete your account at any time in **Settings > Delete account** or at [https://{{INDIA_WEB_DOMAIN}}/legal/account-deletion](/legal/account-deletion).

## 2. Personal data we collect

The table below is the complete list of data the app collects. It is the same list we declare in the Google Play **Data safety** form and in Apple's **App Privacy** labels.

| Data | Examples | Source | Required? | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | Display name; business name for sellers | You, or Google / Apple sign-in | Required | Account, showing who sent a request or quote |
| Email address | Address from Google or Apple sign-in (may be an Apple relay address), or one you add | You, Google, Apple | Optional | Account management, receipts and GST invoices, service messages, support, promotional messages only if you opt in |
| Phone number | Your +91 mobile number, verified by one-time code | You | Required | Sign-in, fraud prevention, shared with the seller you accept (buyers) or the buyer who accepts you (sellers), marketing messages only if you opt in |
| Address | Delivery or service address; shop address for sellers | You | Required to post a request or verify as a seller | Matching requests to nearby sellers, delivery, seller verification |
| Precise location | GPS position when you tap "Use my location" | Your device, only with your permission and only while the app is in use | Optional | Placing a request pin, distance to sellers, seller service area |
| Approximate location | PIN code, city, locality derived from your address or GPS | You, your device | Required to post a request | Matching and showing sellers the area of a request (never the exact address before acceptance); city-level analytics (Firebase Analytics derives it from your IP address) |
| User ID | Our internal account ID | Generated by us | Required | Account management, linking your requests, quotes and chats |
| Device or other IDs | Push notification token, Firebase installation ID, App Check token | Your device, Firebase | Required | Sending notifications, analytics, fraud and abuse prevention |
| Messages | In-app chat between buyers and sellers, counter-offers, messages you send to our support team from the app | You | Optional | Providing chat and customer support, safety (reports, spam and scam detection) |
| Photos and videos | Request photos, seller and shop photos, review photos | You, through the system photo picker or camera | Optional | Showing your request, profile or review |
| Files and documents | Seller verification documents (GST certificate, shop photo, licences such as RERA, IRDAI or medical council registration) | You | Required for verification or restricted categories | Seller verification, licence checks, fraud prevention |
| Other user content | Request text (typed or dictated), quotes, reviews, reports, business profile, GSTIN, Udyam number, licence numbers | You | Required to use the features | Providing the marketplace, verification, safety |
| Purchase history | Seller plans and quote-credit packs bought, renewals, refunds, GST invoices | Google Play, Apple, Razorpay | Required for sellers who buy | Granting and managing seller entitlements, GST and accounting |
| App interactions | Screens viewed, buttons tapped, requests posted, quotes sent | Firebase Analytics, Google Maps SDK | Firebase Analytics events are optional and off until you opt in (Settings > Privacy > Analytics). Basic map usage data is collected by the Google Maps SDK whenever you use a map | Analytics to improve the app (only with your consent); map features |
| Crash logs | Stack traces at the time of a crash | Firebase Crashlytics | Required | Fixing crashes |
| Diagnostics | App version, OS version, device model, performance and error data | Firebase Crashlytics, Supabase | Required | Fixing bugs, keeping the Service stable |

**What we do not collect:** contacts, calendar, SMS or call logs (one-time codes may be auto-filled by Android's SMS Retriever / iOS code autofill, which do not give us access to your messages), health data, web browsing history, background location, Aadhaar numbers, the Android Advertising ID or Apple's IDFA, or card, UPI PIN or bank account credentials (payments are entered only on Google Play, Apple, or Razorpay's own payment pages; we receive only a payment reference, plan, amount and status). The microphone is used only for voice input: speech is converted to text by your device's speech-recognition service (Google or Apple) and we receive the text, not the audio.

**Data we receive from others:** your name and email from Google or Apple if you use their sign-in; payment status from Google Play, Apple and Razorpay; GSTIN validity from GST public search when a seller verifies; reports about you from other users.

**Website and seller dashboard:** our websites collect the IP address, browser type and pages requested in server logs, and use the cookies described in our [Cookie Policy](/legal/cookie-policy).

## 3. How and why we use personal data

We process personal data on the basis of your consent given through the [DPDP Consent Notice](/legal/dpdp-consent-notice), and for legitimate uses permitted by Section 7 of the DPDP Act (for example where you voluntarily provide data for a specific purpose, or to comply with law or a court order). We use it to:

1. Create and secure your account and sign you in (phone one-time code, Google or Apple).
2. Run the marketplace: post requests, match them to sellers by category and service area (PIN code or radius), deliver quotes, chat, accept quotes, track orders and publish reviews.
3. Verify sellers (GSTIN, shop photo, optional Udyam number), check licences for restricted categories and show "Verified" badges.
4. Send notifications you asked for (new quotes, messages, order updates) and service messages. Promotional messages by SMS, WhatsApp or email are sent only if you opt in, through DLT-registered templates where required, and you can opt out at any time.
5. Keep the Service safe: detect fake or duplicate requests, spam, scams and abuse; enforce our [Terms of Service](/legal/terms-of-service) and [Community Guidelines](/legal/community-guidelines); handle reports, blocks and grievances; moderate uploaded photos.
6. Process seller plan and quote-credit purchases and issue GST invoices.
7. Analyze usage (only if you opt in) and fix crashes and bugs.
8. Comply with Indian law, including the IT Rules and directions of CERT-In, and respond to lawful requests from authorities.

We do not use automated decision-making that produces legal or similarly significant effects. Seller ranking in quote lists is explained in our [Seller Terms](/legal/seller-terms).

## 4. What other users see

- **Sellers matching your request** see its category, description, photos, quantity, needed-by date, your budget (unless you hide it), the locality or PIN code (not the exact address) and your display name.
- **After you accept a quote**, that seller also sees your exact address and phone number so they can deliver or provide the service. Before acceptance, contact happens only through in-app chat.
- **Seller profiles** (business name, photos, description, categories, service area, rating, reviews, verification badge, GSTIN and licence numbers for restricted categories) are public.
- **Reviews** you write are public with your display name.

## 5. Data Processors and other recipients

We share personal data only with Data Processors that process it on our behalf under a valid contract, with other users as described above, and where required by law.

| Processor | Purpose | Data | Location |
|---|---|---|---|
| Supabase, Inc. (on Amazon Web Services) | Database, authentication, file storage, realtime chat, server functions | All account and marketplace data | AWS ap-south-1 (Mumbai, India) |
| Google Firebase (Google LLC): Cloud Messaging, Crashlytics, Analytics, Remote Config, App Check | Push notifications, crash reports, usage analytics (if you opt in), feature settings, app integrity | Device IDs, push tokens, crash and diagnostics data, app interactions, user ID | India and other Google locations |
| Google Maps Platform (Maps SDK, Places, Geocoding) | Maps, address search and conversion of addresses to coordinates | Address text, map position, IP address | Google locations |
| Google Cloud Vision | Automated screening of uploaded images for unsafe content | Uploaded photos | Google locations |
| Google Sign-In and Sign in with Apple | Sign-in | Name, email, sign-in token | Google / Apple |
| MSG91 (DLT-registered) | Sending one-time sign-in codes through DLT-registered templates | Phone number | India |
| Google Play Billing and Apple App Store | In-app purchase of seller plans and credits | Purchase records | Google / Apple |
| Razorpay Software Private Limited | Web payments for seller plans and credits (cards, UPI, UPI AutoPay, net banking) | Name, email, phone, purchase details (payment credentials go directly to Razorpay) | India |
| Vercel Inc. | Hosting our websites and seller dashboard | IP address, server logs | Global edge network |
| Cloudflare Turnstile and Upstash | Bot protection and rate limiting on forms and APIs | IP address, browser signals, user ID | Global |
| Our email delivery provider (Resend or Brevo) | Sending receipts, service and opted-in emails | Email address, message content | United States / EU |

**Transfers outside India.** Your primary data is stored in India. Some processors (for example Google, Vercel and our email provider) may process data outside India. We transfer personal data outside India only as permitted by Section 16 of the DPDP Act and never to a country or territory that the Central Government has restricted.

We may also disclose personal data (a) to comply with law, a court order or a lawful request from a government agency, including under the IT Rules, (b) to protect the rights, safety or property of users, the public or Calecute Technologies (OPC) Private Limited, including fraud prevention, or (c) to a successor in a merger, amalgamation or sale of business, subject to this policy.

## 6. Retention

We keep personal data only as long as needed for the purpose for which it was collected, and erase it when you withdraw consent or delete your account, unless the law requires us to keep it.

| Data | How long we keep it |
|---|---|
| Account and profile | While your account is open; erased or anonymized within 30 days after you delete it or withdraw consent |
| Requests, quotes, chats, photos | While your account is open; erased or anonymized within 30 days after account deletion. The other party keeps their own copy of a completed order record, with your details anonymized |
| Reviews | Kept with your name removed after account deletion so seller ratings stay accurate |
| Inactive accounts | If you do not use the Service for 3 years we will notify you at least 48 hours in advance and then erase your account |
| Seller verification and licence documents | While you are a seller, plus 12 months after you stop, for fraud prevention |
| Purchase records and GST invoices | 8 years, as required by the Companies Act, 2013 and GST law |
| Content removed under the IT Rules and related user records | 180 days after removal, or longer if required by a court or authority |
| Reports, blocks, suspensions | Up to 3 years, to prevent banned users from returning |
| Consent records | While the consent is active plus 3 years |
| Analytics data | 14 months |
| Crash reports | 90 days |
| Server and security logs | 180 days, stored in India, as required by CERT-In directions |
| Backups | Overwritten within 35 days |

## 7. Your rights as a Data Principal

Under the DPDP Act you have the right to:

- **Access** a summary of the personal data we process about you and the processing activities, and the identities of the Data Fiduciaries and Data Processors with whom it has been shared (Settings > Privacy > Download my data, or email {{PRIVACY_EMAIL}}).
- **Correction, completion and updating** of inaccurate or incomplete data (edit your profile in the app or email us).
- **Erasure** of your data (Settings > Delete account, or the [Account Deletion page](/legal/account-deletion)), except data we must keep by law.
- **Withdraw consent** at any time, as easily as you gave it: Settings > Privacy > Manage consent. Withdrawal does not affect processing already done. If you withdraw consent needed to run your account, we will close it.
- **Grievance redressal**: contact our [Grievance Officer](/legal/grievance-officer). If you are not satisfied with our response you may complain to the Data Protection Board of India.
- **Nominate** another person to exercise your rights in the event of your death or incapacity (Settings > Privacy > Nominee, or email us).

We will respond to rights requests within 30 days, and to grievances within the timelines on the [Grievance Officer](/legal/grievance-officer) page. We may verify your identity by confirming control of your registered phone number.

You may also manage your consent through a Consent Manager registered with the Data Protection Board once such services are available.

## 8. Security

We use reasonable security practices and procedures in line with the IT Act and the DPDP Act: encryption in transit (TLS) and at rest, row-level security rules so users can only read the data they are allowed to see, private storage for verification documents, least-privilege staff access with logging, and regular review of our safeguards. If a personal data breach occurs, we will inform affected users and the Data Protection Board of India, and report cyber incidents to CERT-In, within the timelines the law prescribes.

## 9. Children

You must be at least 18 years old to create an account. We do not knowingly process the personal data of children (persons under 18) and we do not allow accounts for children, so we do not carry out tracking, behavioural monitoring or targeted advertising directed at children. If we learn that a child has created an account without verifiable consent from a parent or lawful guardian, we will delete the account and its data. Parents or guardians can contact {{PRIVACY_EMAIL}}.

## 10. Changes

We will post changes on this page and update the version and date above. If a change is material we will tell you in the app and ask for your consent again before it applies to you.

## 11. Contact

Calecute Technologies (OPC) Private Limited
Registered office: {{ADDRESS}}
Privacy questions and rights requests: {{PRIVACY_EMAIL}}
Grievance Officer: {{GRIEVANCE_OFFICER}}, {{GRIEVANCE_EMAIL}} · [Grievance Officer page](/legal/grievance-officer)
Support: {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}} · [Contact and Support](/legal/contact-support)

title: DPDP Consent Notice
markdown:
# Consent Notice under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023

_Version 1.0.0 · Last updated 2026-10-02_

This notice is shown to you before you create an I Want India account and whenever we ask for a new consent. It is given by **Calecute Technologies (OPC) Private Limited** (CIN {{CIN}}), {{ADDRESS}}, the **Data Fiduciary** for your personal data. It is available in English and Hindi; tap **हिन्दी** at the top of the screen to read it in Hindi. Our full [Privacy Policy](/legal/privacy-policy) gives more detail.

## 1. What we ask you to agree to

You can give or refuse each consent separately. Only consent A is needed to use the app.

### A. Account and marketplace (required)

| Personal data | Purpose |
|---|---|
| Name, +91 mobile number, email (if you sign in with Google or Apple) | Create and secure your account, sign you in, send service messages |
| Delivery or service address, PIN code, and GPS location when you choose "Use my location" | Match your request to nearby sellers; show sellers only your locality until you accept a quote |
| Requests (text, photos, budget, dates), quotes, chat messages, reviews | Run the marketplace: send your request to matching sellers, show quotes, chat, orders and reviews |
| Your phone number and exact address, shared only with the seller whose quote you accept | Let that seller deliver or provide the service |
| Seller details: business name, GSTIN, Udyam number, shop photos, registrations and licences | Verify sellers and check registrations for restricted categories |
| Purchase records for seller plans and credits | Grant plan benefits, issue GST invoices |
| Device and push notification IDs, crash and diagnostic data | Send notifications, keep the app working, prevent fraud and abuse |

### B. Usage analytics (optional, off by default)

| Personal data | Purpose |
|---|---|
| App interactions (screens viewed, features used) linked to a pseudonymous ID | Understand how the app is used and improve it (Firebase Analytics) |

### C. Offers and updates (optional, off by default)

| Personal data | Purpose |
|---|---|
| Mobile number, email, push token | Send offers, tips and product news by push notification, email, SMS or WhatsApp (SMS and WhatsApp only through DLT-registered templates) |

Location, camera, photos, microphone (voice input) and notifications also need your device permission, which you can refuse or withdraw in your phone's settings at any time.

## 2. Withdrawing consent

You can withdraw any consent at any time, as easily as you gave it:

- In the app: **Settings > Privacy > Manage consent** (switch B or C off, or withdraw A by deleting your account).
- By email to {{PRIVACY_EMAIL}}.

After you withdraw, we stop processing the data for that purpose within a reasonable time and erase it unless the law requires us to keep it (for example GST invoices). Withdrawal does not affect processing done before it. If you withdraw consent A, we will close your account because we cannot run the marketplace for you without it.

## 3. Your rights

You have the right to access a summary of your personal data, to correction, completion, updating and erasure, to grievance redressal, and to nominate a person to exercise your rights in the event of your death or incapacity. Use **Settings > Privacy**, email {{PRIVACY_EMAIL}}, or contact our Grievance Officer.

## 4. Complaints

Grievance Officer: **{{GRIEVANCE_OFFICER}}**, {{GRIEVANCE_OFFICER_DESIGNATION}}, {{GRIEVANCE_EMAIL}}, {{GRIEVANCE_PHONE}} ([details and timelines](/legal/grievance-officer)).

If you are not satisfied with our response, you may complain to the **Data Protection Board of India** in the manner it prescribes.

## 5. Record of your consent

When you tap **Agree**, we record which consents you gave, the version of this notice and the [Terms of Use](/legal/terms-of-service) and [Privacy Policy](/legal/privacy-policy) you accepted, and the date and time. You can see your current choices in Settings > Privacy > Manage consent.

## 6. Children

You must be 18 or older to use I Want India. If you are under 18, do not create an account.

# Grievance Officer

_Version 1.0.0 · Last updated 2026-10-02_

In accordance with the Information Technology Act, 2000, Rule 3(2) of the Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules, 2021, the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020 and the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, the details of the Grievance Officer of Calecute Technologies (OPC) Private Limited for I Want India are:

| | |
|---|---|
| Name | {{GRIEVANCE_OFFICER}} |
| Designation | {{GRIEVANCE_OFFICER_DESIGNATION}} |
| Email | {{GRIEVANCE_EMAIL}} |
| Phone | {{GRIEVANCE_PHONE}} |
| Address | Calecute Technologies (OPC) Private Limited, {{ADDRESS}} |
| Working hours | Monday to Saturday, 10am to 6pm IST |

The Grievance Officer also handles questions and complaints about the processing of your personal data under the DPDP Act, 2023.

## What you can raise

- Content or conduct on I Want India that violates our [Terms of Use](/legal/terms-of-service) (including the content rules in Section 7) or [Community Guidelines](/legal/community-guidelines)
- Complaints about a seller, a quote or an order, including consumer complaints under the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020
- Objections to our action on your content or account (removal, suspension)
- Requests and complaints about your personal data, including access, correction, erasure and consent withdrawal
- Intellectual property complaints

## How to file a grievance

1. In the app: **Settings > Help and support > Raise a grievance**, or
2. Email {{GRIEVANCE_EMAIL}} with the subject "Grievance".

Include your name, registered mobile number, a description of the issue, links or screenshots of the content (request, quote, chat, profile or review), and what you would like us to do. You will receive a ticket number.

## Timelines

| Step | Timeline |
|---|---|
| Acknowledgement | Within 24 hours |
| Resolution of a complaint | Within 15 days of receipt |
| Request to remove content that is prohibited under Rule 3(1)(b) of the IT Rules | Acted on within 72 hours of the complaint |
| Content that exposes a person's private area, shows full or partial nudity or sexual acts, or impersonates a person (including morphed images) | Removed or access disabled within 24 hours of the complaint |
| Personal data rights requests under the DPDP Act | Within 30 days, and not later than the period prescribed by the DPDP Rules |

If you are not satisfied with the resolution, you may appeal to the Grievance Appellate Committee constituted under the IT Rules (https://gac.gov.in) within 30 days of our decision, complain to the Data Protection Board of India about personal data matters, or approach the National Consumer Helpline (1915) or a Consumer Commission for consumer complaints.

## Orders from authorities

Orders and requests from government agencies or courts should be sent to {{GRIEVANCE_EMAIL}}. We comply with lawful orders within the timelines set by law.

title: Community Guidelines and Prohibited and Restricted Items
markdown:
# Community Guidelines and Prohibited and Restricted Items

_Version 1.0.0 · Last updated 2026-10-02_

I Want India works when buyers post real needs and sellers send honest quotes. These guidelines apply to everything on the Service: requests, quotes, chat, photos, profiles and reviews. They form part of our [Terms of Use](/legal/terms-of-service) (including the content rules in Section 7, which follow Rule 3(1)(b) of the IT Rules, 2021) and our [Seller Terms](/legal/seller-terms).

## 1. Be honest and respectful

- Post genuine requests and quotes. No fake, duplicate or test requests, bait prices or quotes for items you cannot supply.
- Treat everyone with respect. No harassment, threats, bullying, or content that is insulting on the basis of gender, religion, caste, race, ethnicity, region, language or disability, or that promotes enmity between groups.
- No obscene, pornographic or sexually explicit content, adult services, or anything harmful to children.
- No violent, graphic or shocking content.
- No spam, chain messages, unrelated advertising or scams (for example advance-payment fraud, fake UPI "collect" requests or QR codes sent to receive money).
- Do not share other people's personal information. Never ask buyers for OTPs, UPI PINs, card details or bank logins.
- Do not impersonate any person or business, or misrepresent your registrations, ratings or affiliation.
- Do not post content that infringes intellectual property, including counterfeit or "first copy" goods.

## 2. Allowed, restricted and blocked categories

Every category has one of three states:

- **Allowed**: anyone can request and any verified seller can quote.
- **Restricted (registered sellers only)**: buyers can request, but only sellers who upload and pass review of the required registration can see or quote these requests. The registration type, number, issuing body and expiry are stored and re-checked before expiry. Request and quote screens show the regulatory disclaimer for the category.
- **Blocked**: cannot be requested or quoted at all. Our text classifier also catches free-text requests that try to get around this.

When we are unsure whether a category is lawful to offer, it starts as **Blocked**. The current policy for I Want India is:

| Category | Policy | At launch | Who may quote / licence rule |
|---|---|---|---|
| Insurance (health, motor, life, home) | Restricted (registered sellers only) | **Blocked** until legal sign-off | IRDAI-registered insurer, insurance broker, corporate agent or insurance web aggregator only, with the IRDAI registration number and validity shown on the profile and each quote. |
| Loans, credit and credit cards | Blocked | Same | Not available (RBI digital lending directions). |
| Investments, securities and crypto-assets | Blocked | Same | Not available (SEBI regulations). |
| Real estate sale and rental | Restricted (registered sellers only) | Same | Real estate agent registered with the State RERA authority (agent registration number shown); projects quoted must show their RERA project registration number where registration is required. |
| Legal services | Blocked | Same | Not available (Bar Council of India Rules restrict solicitation and advertising by advocates). |
| Medical practitioners, doctors and clinics | Restricted (registered sellers only) | Same | Practitioner registered with the National Medical Commission or a State Medical Council (or the relevant council for dental, AYUSH and allied practice); registration number shown. No prescriptions or teleconsultations through the app. |
| Medicines and pharmacy | Blocked | Same | Not available. |
| Alcohol, tobacco, vapes and e-cigarettes | Blocked | Same | Not available (e-cigarettes are prohibited under the PECA 2019). |
| Firearms, ammunition, weapons and weapon parts | Blocked | Same | Not available. |
| Contractors (electrical, plumbing, AC, civil) | Allowed | Same | None at platform level. Electrical work must be carried out by persons holding the licence or certificate required by the State electricity rules. |
| Packers and movers | Allowed | Same | None at platform level; GSTIN recommended for a Verified badge. |
| Used vehicles | Allowed | Same | None at platform level. Seller must hold the RC or be an authorised dealer. |
| Everyday goods (appliances, electronics, furniture) and home services | Allowed | Same | None beyond seller verification (GSTIN, shop photo, optional Udyam number). Some appliances must carry a BIS/ISI mark. |

## 3. Always prohibited

Regardless of category, you may not request, offer or quote for:

- Arms, ammunition, explosives and weapons, including items requiring a licence under the Arms Act, 1959.
- Narcotic drugs and psychotropic substances (NDPS Act, 1985), prescription and over-the-counter medicines, and drug paraphernalia.
- Alcohol, tobacco products, e-cigarettes and vapes.
- Counterfeit, "first copy", replica or stolen goods, and goods that infringe a trademark, copyright or patent.
- Adult or sexual services, escort services, and any content sexualising children.
- Loans, credit, chit funds, investments, securities, cryptocurrency, foreign exchange and money transfer services.
- Betting, gambling, lotteries and online money games.
- Wildlife and products protected under the Wild Life (Protection) Act, 1972; human organs and body parts.
- Goods banned or restricted by Indian law, hazardous chemicals, and products sold without a mandatory BIS certification.
- Fake documents, identity documents (including Aadhaar or PAN services), hacking services, personal data or accounts.
- Services that would require you to break the law, including unregistered regulated services and legal services by advocates.

## 4. Regulatory disclaimers

These disclaimers are shown on request and quote screens in the categories they apply to. If insurance is ever enabled, the IRDAI wording below is shown on every insurance request and quote together with the registration number of the IRDAI-registered entity.

- **Insurance (health, motor, life, home):** Insurance is the subject matter of solicitation. Calecute Technologies (OPC) Private Limited is not an insurer, insurance intermediary or web aggregator registered with IRDAI and does not solicit or sell insurance. Quotes are provided by the IRDAI-registered entity named on the quote (IRDAI Reg. No. <shown on each quote>). For details on risk factors, terms, conditions and exclusions, read the sales brochure carefully before concluding a sale.
- **Real estate sale and rental:** Verify the RERA registration of the project and agent on the State RERA website before making any payment. Calecute Technologies (OPC) Private Limited is not a real estate agent and is not party to any property transaction.
- **Medical practitioners, doctors and clinics:** I Want India does not provide medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Do not share detailed health information in requests or chat. In an emergency call 112.
- **Contractors (electrical, plumbing, AC, civil):** Ask your contractor for the relevant licence or certificate for electrical and gas work.
- **Packers and movers:** Ask for a written lorry receipt / goods consignment note and transit insurance details before your goods are loaded.
- **Used vehicles:** Check the RC, insurance, PUC certificate and challan history before you pay, and complete the RTO ownership transfer.
- **Everyday goods (appliances, electronics, furniture) and home services:** Prices include GST unless the quote says otherwise. Ask for a GST invoice.

## 5. Reviews

Reviews must reflect a real, completed order. No paid, incentivised, swapped or self-written reviews, and no threats to leave a bad review to get a discount. Sellers may reply once, politely.

## 6. Enforcement and grievances

You can **report** and **block** any user, request, quote, chat or review. Content with several reports may be hidden automatically while we review it. Uploaded photos are screened automatically for unsafe content. Depending on severity we may remove or disable access to content, issue a warning, limit features, remove a Verified badge, or suspend or terminate the account, and we may report unlawful content to the authorities as required by law. If we remove your content we will tell you why, and you can ask our [Grievance Officer](/legal/grievance-officer) to review the decision.

If you see something that puts someone in immediate danger, call 112.

# Seller Terms

_Version 1.0.0 · Last updated 2026-10-02_

These Seller Terms form part of the [Terms of Use](/legal/terms-of-service) and apply when you use I Want India as a seller ("you"). If you accept them on behalf of a business, you confirm you are authorised to bind it. If anything here conflicts with the Terms of Use, these Seller Terms apply to your seller activity.

## 1. Who can sell

- You must be a business, shop or self-employed professional lawfully operating in India, at least 18 years old, with a +91 mobile number verified by one-time code.
- You are an independent business. Nothing in these terms creates an employment, agency, partnership or joint-venture relationship with Calecute Technologies (OPC) Private Limited.

## 2. Verification and registrations

- To earn a **Verified** badge you must provide your GSTIN (we validate its format and checksum and may check it on the GST portal), a photo of your shop or business premises and, optionally, your Udyam registration number. Businesses not required to register for GST may be verified on other documents at our discretion. We review submissions manually and may ask for more documents.
- For **restricted categories** (see the [Community Guidelines](/legal/community-guidelines)) you must upload the registration the category requires (for example IRDAI registration for insurance, State RERA agent registration for real estate, NMC or State Medical Council registration for medical practitioners). We store the registration type, number, issuing body and expiry, re-check it before expiry, and hide restricted requests from you if a registration lapses or cannot be verified.
- You must keep verification information accurate and tell us within 7 days if a registration is suspended, cancelled or expires.
- A badge means we checked the information available to us at that time. It is not an endorsement or guarantee.

## 3. Lead feed and quoting rules

- You see open requests that match your categories and service area (radius from your shop, a list of PIN codes, or nationwide shipping). Requests show the locality or PIN code, not the buyer's exact address or contact details.
- Each request accepts up to 10 quotes, first come, first served. New requests may first be shown only to Verified sellers for a short priority window (currently 15 minutes).
- Your quote must be complete and honest: price per item, quantity, GST rate with the CGST/SGST (same state) or IGST (inter-state) split, delivery or installation charges, total, brand and model offered, delivery or service date, warranty and validity. Where the law requires it, state the country of origin, BIS/ISI mark and energy star rating. The total shown to the buyer is the amount you expect to be paid. Do not quote an item you cannot supply or a lower "bait" price you will not honour.
- Honour an accepted quote at the quoted price for its validity period, unless the buyer changes the request.
- Before a buyer accepts your quote, communicate through in-app chat. Asking buyers to move off the platform before acceptance, or sharing contact details to avoid the platform, may lead to warnings or suspension.
- After acceptance you receive the buyer's address and phone number. Use them **only** to complete that order. You process that data as an independent Data Fiduciary under the DPDP Act and must protect it, must not sell or share it, and must not send promotional calls, SMS or WhatsApp messages to the buyer without their consent and in compliance with TRAI's commercial communication regulations.
- You are responsible for collecting payment, issuing a GST invoice, paying GST, warranties, returns and complying with all laws that apply to your business and products or services, including the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020 (including seller information disclosure), the Legal Metrology Act, 2009 and BIS standards.
- We may set rate limits (for example maximum quotes per hour) and remove quotes that break these terms.

## 4. Fees, launch period and early partners

- **Launch period.** While monetization is switched off, all seller features are free and no paywall is shown.
- **Founding partners.** Sellers who join before monetization starts are marked as early partners and keep free access until **{{EARLY_PARTNER_FREE_UNTIL}}**, shown as "Founding partner: free until <date>" in the app. This is not a promise of free access for life.
- **After monetization starts**, sellers get 10 free quotes per month. Beyond that you can buy a **seller subscription** (monthly or annual; higher or unlimited quote limits, Verified-first priority window, featured placement and analytics) or **quote-credit packs**. Prices are in Indian Rupees including GST. Billing periods, renewal and cancellation are shown before purchase and explained in the [Subscription Terms](/legal/subscription-terms) and [Refund and Cancellation Policy](/legal/refund-cancellation).
- Payments are processed by Google Play, Apple, or Razorpay (cards, UPI, UPI AutoPay, net banking) on our seller dashboard at https://{{INDIA_SELLER_DASHBOARD_DOMAIN}}. We issue a GST invoice for each payment made to us (our GSTIN: {{COMPANY_GSTIN}}); enter your GSTIN at checkout to claim input tax credit. We will give at least 30 days' notice of any new fee or price increase that affects you.
- We do not take a commission on buyer-to-seller payments in the current version of the Service. If we introduce in-app payments or commission in the future, we will ask you to accept updated terms first.

## 5. Ranking and sponsored placement

As required by the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020, we explain the main parameters that decide where your quotes and profile appear:

- **Quote lists** for a buyer are sorted by the option the buyer chooses (price, rating, delivery date or distance). The default order considers total price including GST, delivery date, distance, your rating and number of completed orders, your response time, and whether you are Verified.
- **Lead feed** order is newest first, filtered by category and service area, with the Verified-first priority window described above.
- **Featured placement** is available to subscribers after monetization starts. Featured profiles and quotes are always clearly labelled **"Sponsored"**. Paying never changes a buyer's chosen sort order, your reviews or your rating.
- We do not accept payment to remove or alter reviews.

## 6. Prohibited items and conduct

You must not quote for blocked categories, quote in restricted categories without a verified registration, or break the [Community Guidelines](/legal/community-guidelines) or Section 7 of the Terms of Use. Fake reviews, review swapping, incentivised reviews, shill accounts, price manipulation and harassment of buyers or other sellers are prohibited.

## 7. Content you provide

You grant us the licence in the Terms of Use to your business name, logo, photos and profile content, including to show your profile on our website, in search results and in promotional material for the Service. You confirm you own or may use any brand names, trademarks and images you upload.

## 8. Suspension and removal

We may warn you, hide your quotes, remove your badge, suspend or close your seller account if you break these terms, receive repeated well-founded complaints, a registration lapses, or we are required to by law. We will tell you why unless the law or safety prevents it, and you can appeal to our [Grievance Officer](/legal/grievance-officer). Refunds after suspension follow the [Refund and Cancellation Policy](/legal/refund-cancellation).

## 9. Liability and indemnity

You are solely responsible for your products, services and quotes and for your dealings with buyers. You will indemnify Calecute Technologies (OPC) Private Limited against claims arising from them or from your breach of these terms or the law. The disclaimers and limits of liability in the Terms of Use apply.

## 10. Contact

Seller support: {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}} · Calecute Technologies (OPC) Private Limited, {{ADDRESS}}

# Seller Subscription Terms

_Version 1.0.0 · Last updated 2026-10-02_

These terms are shown before you buy a seller plan or quote credits in I Want India. They supplement the [Seller Terms](/legal/seller-terms) and the [Refund and Cancellation Policy](/legal/refund-cancellation). Buyers never pay to use I Want India.

## 1. Launch period and founding partners

Seller features are currently free while monetization is off. Sellers who join before monetization starts are founding partners and keep free access until **{{EARLY_PARTNER_FREE_UNTIL}}**. You will not be charged unless you choose a plan, and we will tell you at least 30 days before any free access you have ends.

## 2. What you can buy

| Product | Billing | What you get |
|---|---|---|
| Seller plan, monthly | Every month, auto-renewing | Higher or unlimited monthly quote limit, Verified-first priority window on new requests, featured placement labelled "Sponsored", seller analytics |
| Seller plan, annual | Every 12 months, auto-renewing | Same as monthly, at a lower effective monthly price |
| Quote-credit pack | One-time purchase | A fixed number of extra quotes, valid for 12 months |

Without a plan, sellers get 10 free quotes per month once monetization starts. The exact price in Indian Rupees (₹, including GST), billing period and renewal terms are shown on the purchase screen before you confirm. Prices can differ between Google Play, the App Store and our website. For website purchases we issue a GST invoice; add your GSTIN at checkout to claim input tax credit.

## 3. Free trials and introductory offers

If a free trial or introductory price is offered, the purchase screen shows its length and the price you will pay when it ends. Unless you cancel before the trial or introductory period ends, the subscription converts to the regular price shown. Each seller account is eligible for one trial. We may also offer upgrade discounts, offer codes and win-back offers; their terms are shown with the offer.

## 4. Auto-renewal

- **App Store:** Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel subscriptions in your App Store account settings after purchase: https://apps.apple.com/account/subscriptions
- **Google Play:** The subscription renews automatically at the end of each period until cancelled. You can cancel, pause or resubscribe at any time in the Google Play subscription center: https://play.google.com/store/account/subscriptions?package=com.calecute.iwant.india
- **Website (Razorpay):** Recurring payments use a UPI AutoPay or card e-mandate that you approve once, as permitted by RBI rules on recurring transactions. You receive a pre-debit notification at least 24 hours before each charge, with an option to opt out of that charge. Renewals above the RBI limit for automatic debits need your additional authentication. You can cancel in the seller dashboard at https://{{INDIA_SELLER_DASHBOARD_DOMAIN}} or revoke the mandate in your UPI app or with your bank.

## 5. How to cancel

Cancel in the store or dashboard where you subscribed (links above, or Settings > Seller plan > Manage subscription in the app). Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current period, and you keep your benefits until then. Deleting the app does not cancel a store subscription.

## 6. Failed payments, grace period and account hold

If a renewal payment fails, we keep your plan active during the store's grace period and show a "Fix your payment" banner. If payment is not fixed, Google Play may place the subscription on account hold and your plan benefits pause until payment succeeds.

## 7. Price changes

We will tell you before any price increase takes effect. For store subscriptions, Google Play and Apple will notify you and, where their rules require, ask for your consent; if you do not agree, the subscription ends at the end of the current period. For website mandates we will ask you to approve a new mandate where required.

## 8. Restore purchases

If you reinstall the app or switch devices, use **Settings > Seller plan > Restore purchases**. Your plan is linked to your I Want India account, so a plan bought on any platform works on all of them.

## 9. Terms

Purchases are subject to our [Terms of Use](/legal/terms-of-service), [Privacy Policy](/legal/privacy-policy) and, for App Store purchases, the [End User License Agreement](/legal/eula).

# Refund and Cancellation Policy

_Version 1.0.0 · Last updated 2026-10-02_

This policy covers payments made **to Calecute Technologies (OPC) Private Limited** for I Want India seller subscriptions and quote-credit packs. Buyers use I Want India for free.

**Purchases between buyers and sellers are not covered.** Buyers pay sellers directly (UPI, cash or card), outside the Service, so refunds, returns, cancellations and warranty claims for goods or services must be agreed with the seller under the seller's own policy and the Consumer Protection Act, 2019. You can report a seller who refuses to honour an accepted quote or raise a complaint with our [Grievance Officer](/legal/grievance-officer), and we may act against the seller under our [Community Guidelines](/legal/community-guidelines).

## 1. Where you bought determines who handles it

| Where you paid | How to cancel | How to ask for a refund |
|---|---|---|
| Google Play (Android app) | Google Play > Payments & subscriptions > Subscriptions, or the "Manage subscription" link in the app | Google handles refunds under the Google Play refund policy. Within 48 hours of purchase you can request one at play.google.com; after that, contact us and we will review it under Section 3 |
| Apple App Store (iOS app) | iPhone Settings > your name > Subscriptions, or the "Manage subscription" link in the app | Apple handles all refunds at reportaproblem.apple.com. We cannot issue refunds for App Store purchases |
| Our website (seller dashboard, paid with Razorpay) | Seller dashboard > Billing > Cancel plan. For UPI AutoPay you can also revoke the mandate in your UPI app; for card mandates, through your bank | Email {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}}; we review it under Section 3 |

## 2. Cancelling a subscription

- You can cancel at any time. Cancellation stops the next renewal and cancels the recurring mandate; you keep your plan benefits until the end of the period you already paid for.
- Deleting the app or your account does not cancel a Google Play or App Store subscription. Cancel it in the store first. Deleting your I Want India account cancels website subscriptions and their mandates automatically.
- If you cancel during a free trial, you will not be charged. Apple and Google may require you to cancel at least 24 hours before the trial ends.

## 3. Refunds for website purchases

- **Subscriptions.** Payments for a started billing period are non-refundable, except where required by law, for duplicate or mistaken debits, or if the Service was unavailable for a significant part of the period because of a fault on our side. We do not give partial refunds for unused time after cancellation.
- **Annual plans.** If you cancel an annual plan within 14 days of the initial purchase (not a renewal), we refund it in full.
- **Quote-credit packs.** Unused credit packs can be refunded within 14 days of purchase if no credits from the pack have been used. Credits expire 12 months after purchase.
- **Failed transactions.** If money was debited but the purchase failed, it is reversed automatically by Razorpay or your bank, usually within 5 to 7 working days. Contact us if it is not.
- **Account suspension.** If we close your seller account because you broke our Terms, fees already paid are not refunded. If we close it without cause, we refund the unused part of any prepaid period.

## 4. How refunds are paid

Refund requests are answered within 2 working days. Approved refunds are initiated within 7 working days and credited to the original payment method (card, UPI or bank account) through Razorpay; banks usually take a further 5 to 7 working days to show the credit. We issue a GST credit note for every refund. Any unused credits or plan benefits linked to the refunded purchase are removed.

## 5. Contact

{{SUPPORT_EMAIL}} · Calecute Technologies (OPC) Private Limited, {{ADDRESS}} · Grievance Officer: {{GRIEVANCE_OFFICER}} ({{GRIEVANCE_EMAIL}})

# Delete Your I Want India Account

_Version 1.0.0 · Last updated 2026-10-02_

This page explains how to delete your account in **I Want India**, the app published by **Calecute Technologies (OPC) Private Limited**, and what happens to your data. It works without the app installed.

## Option 1: in the app (fastest)

1. Open I Want India and sign in.
2. Go to **Settings > Delete account**.
3. Read what will be deleted and kept, then confirm. For your security we ask you to sign in again (one-time code, Google or Apple).
4. Your account is closed immediately and the deletion completes within 30 days.

If you signed in with Apple, we also revoke I Want India's access to your Apple ID.

## Option 2: without the app

Send a deletion request from this page's form at https://{{INDIA_WEB_DOMAIN}}/legal/account-deletion, or email **{{PRIVACY_EMAIL}}** with the subject "Delete my account" from the email linked to your account, or include your registered phone number. We will send a one-time code to your registered phone number to confirm the request is yours, and confirm when deletion is complete.

## Before you delete

- **Store subscriptions are not cancelled automatically.** Cancel a Google Play or App Store seller plan in the store first. Website plans are cancelled automatically.
- Open requests are closed and open quotes are withdrawn. Sellers you accepted will no longer be able to contact you through the app.
- Unused quote credits and plan time are lost and are not refunded, except as described in the [Refund and Cancellation Policy](/legal/refund-cancellation).

## What is deleted

Within 30 days we delete or irreversibly anonymize:

- Your profile: name, phone number, email, addresses, photo and saved locations
- Requests, quotes, chat messages and uploaded photos and videos
- Seller business profile, business photos and service area
- Notification tokens, device identifiers and preferences
- Analytics data linked to your account ID

Backups containing your data are overwritten within 35 days.

## What is kept, and for how long

Some data must be kept for legal, tax or safety reasons, with access restricted:

- Purchase records and GST invoices for seller plans and credits (kept 8 years under the Companies Act, 2013 and GST law)
- Seller verification and licence records (12 months after deletion, for fraud prevention)
- Records of reports, blocks and suspensions linked to your phone number (up to 3 years, to stop banned users from returning)
- Records of the consents you gave and withdrew (3 years)
- Information about content removed under the IT Rules, 2021 (kept 180 days after removal, or longer if a court or authority requires it)
- Server and security logs (kept 180 days in India under CERT-In directions)
- Reviews you wrote stay published without your name, so sellers' ratings stay accurate
- Order records held by the other party to a completed order show your details anonymized

## Delete some data without deleting your account

You can delete individual requests, photos and reviews in the app, clear saved addresses in Settings > Addresses, turn off analytics in Settings > Privacy, or email {{PRIVACY_EMAIL}} to ask us to delete specific data.

## Questions

Calecute Technologies (OPC) Private Limited, {{ADDRESS}} · {{PRIVACY_EMAIL}}

# Cookie Policy

_Version 1.0.0 · Last updated 2026-10-02_

This policy explains how Calecute Technologies (OPC) Private Limited uses cookies and similar technologies (such as browser local storage) on the I Want India websites: https://{{INDIA_WEB_DOMAIN}} (including the legal, request and seller pages), the seller dashboard at https://{{INDIA_SELLER_DASHBOARD_DOMAIN}} and our admin panel. The mobile app does not use browser cookies; see the [Privacy Policy](/legal/privacy-policy) for what the app collects.

## 1. Cookies we use

| Name or type | Category | Purpose | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sb-<project>-auth-token` (local storage or cookie) | Strictly necessary | Keeps you signed in to the seller dashboard and admin panel (Supabase Auth session) | Until you sign out; refresh token up to 30 days |
| `iwant_consent` | Strictly necessary | Remembers your cookie choices | 12 months |
| `iwant_locale` | Functional | Remembers your language | 12 months |
| Cloudflare Turnstile | Strictly necessary | Bot protection on sign-up, waitlist, contact and report forms | Session |
| `__stripe_mid`, `__stripe_sid` or Razorpay checkout cookies (only on payment pages) | Strictly necessary | Fraud prevention during seller plan checkout by our payment provider (Razorpay) | Up to 1 year / 30 minutes |
| `_vercel_*` (preview deployments only) | Strictly necessary | Access protection for preview sites, not used on the live site | Session |
| Vercel Web Analytics | Analytics (cookieless) | Counts page views in aggregate without cookies or cross-site identifiers | Not stored on your device |

We **do not** use advertising cookies, cross-site tracking pixels or social media tracking cookies, and we do not allow third parties to place advertising cookies on our sites.

## 2. Your choices

Strictly necessary cookies are needed for sign-in, security and payments and cannot be switched off in our cookie settings, but you can block them in your browser (some features will then stop working). Functional cookies can be turned off in **Cookie settings** in the site footer. Non-essential cookies are used only with your consent under the DPDP Act, 2023, which you can withdraw at any time through **Cookie settings** in the footer.

## 3. Changes and contact

We update this policy when we change the cookies we use. Questions: {{PRIVACY_EMAIL}} · Calecute Technologies (OPC) Private Limited, {{ADDRESS}}

# Contact and Support

_Version 1.0.0 · Last updated 2026-10-02_

Need help with I Want India? We're here for buyers and sellers.

## Get help

- **In the app:** Settings > Help and support > Contact us (attaches your app version and account ID so we can help faster)
- **Email:** {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}}
- **Phone:** {{SUPPORT_PHONE}}
- **Hours:** Monday to Saturday, 10am to 6pm IST, excluding national holidays
- **Languages:** English and Hindi

We reply to most messages within 1 business day.

## Report a problem with a user, request, quote or review

Use **Report** on the chat, request, quote, review or profile in the app. You can also **Block** a user so they cannot contact you. Reports are reviewed by our trust and safety team; content with several reports may be hidden while we review it. If anyone is in immediate danger, call **112** first. For cyber fraud, call **1930** or report at cybercrime.gov.in.

## Common topics

- **Sign-in codes not arriving:** check the number and network, wait 60 seconds before requesting a new code, or sign in with Google or Apple.
- **Seller verification:** Settings > Seller profile > Verification shows your status and what is missing.
- **Seller plans and billing:** see [Subscription Terms](/legal/subscription-terms) and [Refund and Cancellation Policy](/legal/refund-cancellation).
- **Delete your account:** see [Delete Your Account](/legal/account-deletion).

## Legal and privacy contacts

- **Grievance Officer (IT Rules, 2021 and DPDP Act, 2023):** {{GRIEVANCE_OFFICER}}, {{GRIEVANCE_OFFICER_DESIGNATION}}, {{GRIEVANCE_EMAIL}}, {{GRIEVANCE_PHONE}}. See the [Grievance Officer page](/legal/grievance-officer) for timelines.
- **Privacy and data rights requests:** {{PRIVACY_EMAIL}}
- **Consumer complaints about a seller:** report the seller in the app or write to the Grievance Officer; you can also call the National Consumer Helpline on 1915
